gaps.title: Missing Inbound Event Listener for Response Monitoring
gaps.jtbd: When a lead responds to a message in a connected account, I want the system to automatically trigger AI evaluation in the background, so that we can maintain real-time automated conversational flow.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a connected Telegram account with an active outreach dialog, When a new inbound message is received from a lead, Then a background event listener detects the message and triggers the AI evaluation engine to determine the next automated turn.
gaps.reason: Literal brief requirement: FEAT-AI-01 explicitly mandates a background worker that monitors connected accounts for incoming responses and triggers AI evaluation, but the current codebase only has an endpoint for manually receiving lead messages via mock API calls.

gaps.title: Missing System Prompt Customization and Persisted Configuration
gaps.jtbd: When launching a campaign, I want to configure custom system prompt templates (FAQ, personas, goals, tone of voice), so that the AI dialog engine aligns its automated messages with the campaign's specific objectives.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a newly created campaign, When the administrator updates the system prompt settings, Then the custom prompt defining AI persona, sales goals, FAQ, and qualification rules is saved and supplied to the AI generation engine during dialogue evaluation.
gaps.reason: Literal brief requirement: FEAT-AI-03 specifies a configurable prompt template defining AI persona, sales goal, tone of voice, product FAQs, and qualification rules, which is completely absent from the database schema and application code.
